title: Love so far!!
text:
Just joined, got my first shirt, kittur chenamma, and really love it! Great design & flattering fit, I’d say runs just slightly large. My measurements are 39-31-41 & a women’s XL is a comfy loose fit on me, just what I was looking for. I haven’t washed it yet so it’ll probably shrink a little. This one is 100% cotton but according to the description they aren’t all. But this one is just lovely, with nice material & a flattering cut. Very happy so far!

Update 11/2021:
Well I can now say it’s a bit hit or miss. I have a few tshirts I love and wear all the time (Kittur Chenamma, Tenye Wa Chesh Gut, Beltalowda Coffee) but more that I don’t care for including a couple I wouldn’t be seen out of the house in (I am That Guy- terrible cheap looking graphics, Baltimore Crab Juice- the can is cool but the stupid font on the show name just ruins it, Avasarala- the design is cheap looking and the tshirt itself is too short and super cheap material, both the Truman Class warship & Property of UNN shirts merely bcuz they are polyester blends rather than 100% cotton so I’ll never wear them… but the designs are ok). The nice thing is you are notified of your subscription shortly before they’re sent so if you’re paying attention to your email and don’t like the design you can cancel that shipment. But I think I will probably cancel my subscription soon… I’ve kind of been waiting for the Holden one, Remember the Cant, but who knows how long it will take to come back around as I think the subscription started on that one. I wish they’d make a cool Drummer one. I’d probably be better off just ordering shirts separately on here. Anyway, all in all I’d say meh. It’s a great idea but not well executed, they need better graphic artists and quality control

Update 1/4/2022: I cancelled my subscription, just too hit or miss. If they put more effort into this idea and made them all quality items with great designs I’d resubscribe in a heartbeat. I added photos of the rest of the designs for your perusal :)
label: neutral
